Alice —

Thanks again for the thoughtful demo yesterday. As we discussed, the Juniper pilot team asked to speak with a couple of customers who have completed a core-banking migration / ledger consolidation on Redwood with similar constraints (low-latency posting, multi-tenant isolation, and compliance-ready audit trails). To keep the conversation productive, could you confirm the specific areas you want the references to speak to (latency, rollback testing, reconciliation, SLAs, or procurement/contract lessons)?

If helpful, we can curate two reference options:
- One institution that completed a migration and now runs post-trade reconciliation on Redwood (can speak to throughput + batching choices).
- One peer who validated latency SLOs and has a short writeup we can share in advance.

We have one short reference brief attached with suggested redactions. If you’re comfortable, share two 60-minute windows next week (US ET) and we’ll route the right contacts.

Thanks,

2) Helix Bank (mid-market challenger) — Ellen Roe, VP Engineering (ellen.roe@helixbank.io). They stress-tested latency during peak settlement windows and can share SLA tuning tips.

Both contacts have previously agreed to field reference calls for similar prospects; I’ve attached a roster with short notes and suggested call moderators. I’ll also attach an editable one-pager we can send in advance.
